Beach water quality over time








Figure 2: Mean annual E. coli by beach, 2007-2026. The dashed line marks Ontario’s posting threshold of 100 MPN/100 mL, applied to the geometric mean of five samples rather than to annual means. One implausible reading of 6,191,768 MPN/100 mL has been removed. Data from Open Data Toronto.
